text_block_list.name: Japanese Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Japan, who had never won before...!
The long-awaited first BC victory...!"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Breaking through the towering wall of the powerhouse nations that stood in their way for years, they didn't just stop at one win, they achieved multiple victories...!!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
~~~~~~~~~~~gh!
YOU DID IIIIIIIIITTTTTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit... That's the spirit...! The horse girls who shoulder the future of Japan...! The pride... of our Tracen Academy...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: This great achievement... was made possible not by an "individual", but by the "solidarity" of our team...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
More will surely cross the ocean to take on the challenge in America.
And the way America views us should begin to change, step by step...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Those who carried on the feelings I left behind...
and fulfilled them, huh.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps all hoofprints lead toward the same future.
And my new dream as well—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"This is a historic first, and it seems poised
to influence various industries going forward."

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: "Yes, perhaps not just within the Umamusume world, but we'll also see more people and companies inspired to take on challenges abroad, wouldn't you say?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, the environment surrounding Umamusume will change as well.
Just like overseas, specialized education is bound to become widespread."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"‘More girls will surely aim to become dirt Umamusume now.
It might even reshape the balance of power across the Umamusume world.’"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in "DREAMS"!
Let's take a photo, a photo!
choice_data_list: Casino Drive. Here, let me put this lei on you.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
No, but this victory belongs to everyone—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're the hero of this team.
So think of this as a special reward, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
... ......Ah, so this is—
what "she" once held in her hands...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
How do you feel?
Could you give us your honest thoughts right now?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You're... right.
It's heavy... so very heavy.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
It's not like it's packed with iron or lead—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It is heavy. It's the weight of the dreams
that so many Umamusume and supporters have pursued.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
(O past self from my childhood days... That brilliance that once captivated you,
I have now, at long last, truly reached it...)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: (To the me on that day of despair... The feelings of that day when you vowed to rise again... have finally borne fruit right here.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Casino-san. Let me snap a few
for the 『DREAMS』 promo too, okay?♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "That's it, give us your brightest smile!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right...!
Let's laugh our hearts out, all of us...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: —Glory lies only beyond passion and challenge!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
May there be chances and blessings
for all aspiring challengers in the days ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, this year's Breeders' Cup became a historic turning point for the Japanese racing world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And as time passed,
several months had gone by since the BC, marking two and a half years
sprinted alongside our comrades in DREAMS.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer.
And it has been quite a while.
choice_data_list: Good work. Looks like you're pretty busy.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"If you put it that way,
shouldn't that apply to everyone else in 'DREAMS'?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Until I beat down every single strong Umamusume in the world,
I ain't stoppin'.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep running to the absolute end and win every damn race! I don't care who it is... ain't nobody running in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Her desire for strength knows no bounds.
She will surely continue to rack up victories in countless races to come."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Even after the BC, I remain not in "that land,"
but here in this land...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Surely this is because I still have
things left to accomplish in this world.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, I must shine hope upon
even more people and grow as a holy maiden."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Someday, she will surely arrive there too. Beyond the fulfillment of her new dream.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, teacherrr!
I wanna run in the BC too!
What do I gotta do to get in?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu. It might be nice to have a friend to work hard together with, like me and Teacher Maru-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Love-chan is doing a proper job, isn't she?
As the 'Kids' Race Club Teacher for a Day.'"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "They said requests came flooding in after the BC. I hope more girls get inspired to race! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true. Maybe it wouldn't be so bad if we both actually became teachers in the future♪
Passing on our "love" to the next generation... ♡

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Taking an interest in passing knowledge to the next generation is wonderful.
Ah, speaking of training our juniors—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since the BC, calls from overseas
for leading Japanese Umamusume to compete have only increased."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, the URA plans to cooperate with
overseas organizations to design systems that make
expeditions and exchanges much smoother.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did something come my way too?
Like an invitation?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ho!
And what do you plan to do about it?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds fun. If I race and make friends
in all kinds of countries—
it'll make everyone go 'Japanese racing is hype!', right?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Then it'll be easier to take on international challenges, and more overseas challengers will come here too!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: "And what else, maybe an overseas concert for us? The URA would love that too, hehe♪"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I want to create a roadmap that'll set the Japanese racing scene on fire!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"I am an innovator!
Let's create a new era and new values
together with me☆"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
One can never have too many dreams.
Both for them—and for us.
choice_data_list: Yeah. So... shall we begin our next dream?
Yeah. So... shall we begin our next dream?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Now that we've achieved multiple BC victories,
we're receiving even more offers of support and cooperation than last year.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Besides, many talented Umamusume have voiced their desire to participate as athletes.
In that case, our next goal should be—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Grandiose talk... it wouldn't be surprising if people called it that. ...If it were in the past, that is.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Until now, Japan has absorbed and learned so much
from racing powerhouses, using it to fuel our growth.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
And now that we have shown solid results,
the time has come to shift to a new direction.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: We evolve what we have gained, elevating it to the point where we can give back to the world.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Overtaking, being overtaken, and overtaking once again—
...This endless cycle of evolution that transcends national borders will surely continue to advance the global racing world.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
By then, I believe the new dream we just set
will surely have been achieved. As long as it's us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes years from now. If we show the way
and connect our passion and experience, we will reach it.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin.
The journey toward a new "American Dream."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
We must always strive for greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond Dreams"!
Let us journey on endlessly together!
